verdict.rationale: telli exposes a full REST API (with OpenAPI spec) to programmatically schedule calls, manage contacts, and trigger workflows, plus webhooks for event-driven automation and scheduled/recurring workflow triggers — all of which support headless, non-UI automation suitable for CI-like pipelines. However there is no explicit CI/CD example, CLI tool, or documented automated pipeline integration beyond the API/webhook primitives. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/CD documentation or examples, a CLI for scripted invocation, and independent confirmation of headless use in production pipelines.
